title: Today I Read Quite by Accident… (collected absurd prose)
tone_mechanism: Escalation without inflection: sentence length, vocabulary, and clause rhythm stay constant while stakes rise to death and catastrophe; catastrophe is processed as paperwork (inventory clauses, sequential 'then' parataxis, administrative passivity). The deadpan lives in sentence order, not in any character's voice — prose-native deadpan, no performer required.
verification_note: English collection, 2007 (Glas/Pushkin House); translator attribution (Anna Mohr) standard for this edition but not re-verified page-by-page. Translation-mediated: Russian paratactic rhythm is flattened in English — flagged as transfer limitation in claim records. No sibling silo owns a Kharms record (checked 2026-09-24).
